en.title: Restless and SKØLL – Live
en.lead: A free concert of northern Norwegian punk, metal and hardcore.
en.text: Restless and SKØLL play at Tvibit Scene. SKØLL blends hardcore punk, pop punk and proto-garage punk, while Restless combines metal and punk. The event is free and open to everyone.
